minutes.headline: Select Board approved the Bliss cannabis host agreement 3-1 and adopted a workplace climate survey policy.
minutes.summary: The board heard the town manager's report, tabled the 56 Carr Avenue tax-title matter until spring, and voted on a cannabis host agreement and a workplace climate survey policy. Members discussed the school budget deficit, a possible joint meeting with the School Committee, the warrant timeline, and CPA timing. The chair announced he will not seek reelection.

public_comment.topic: Asked for more context on existing town buildings when the municipal building design committee reports.
Said he was not sent Zoom details for a Finance Committee interview; raised records request appeals, cable access expenses, and his tax and valuation concerns.
Cited federal per-pupil money and asked the board to address election interference from handing off voting clickers at town meeting.

Approve the workplace climate survey policy as section 2.13 of the select board policies and procedures.
Approve the ARPA press release with revisions as discussed.

Try to schedule a joint meeting or special meeting with the School Committee; date not settled.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted 3-1 to authorize the town manager to sign the host community agreement with Bliss cannabis (Uma Flowers Lunenburg).
The board unanimously approved a workplace climate survey policy as section 2.13 of its policies and procedures.
The board tabled the 56 Carr Avenue tax-title matter until spring, aiming for the first meeting in April.
Members said they would try to set a joint or special meeting with the School Committee on the school deficit; no date was settled.
Warrant recommendation votes are planned for March 11, with March 18 possible for the rest and an April 3 printer date; the tax investigation report is set for March 18.

why_it_matters: The cannabis host agreement is the town's contract with a retailer, so it sets terms between the town and the business, and the 3-1 split shows the board was not of one mind on it.
The school deficit, the planned joint meeting and the warrant dates all feed what goes on the Town Meeting warrant, so they shape which budget questions residents are asked to vote on this spring.
watch_next: March 11 and March 18: Select Board warrant recommendation votes, plus the tax investigation report on March 18.
April 3: the warrant printer date, and a possible joint meeting with the School Committee, which has no date yet.
